Tuesday, February 28, 1922,
No. 45

THE DISCLOSURE OF A MURDER.

The Murder of a Soviet Agent - Mystery of
the dead body at Alekseyevka.

The body of the unknown person found murdered in
the village Alekseyevka has been identified; it is
the body of the Commissar Vyshnegrad. The authorities
have established his identity.
When his house was searched, a number of his papers
and documents were found, which explained in detail the
work of the murdered Commissar.
Secret letters written on silk, show that he was
charged with the establishing of a Soviet Agency in
Harbin, under the disguise of opening a trade-office.
He was further assured therein that the money required
for the establishment and organization of that agency
would be transferred to him within the next few days.
The localities of the city, mentioned in those letters
were designated by pre-arranged numbers. Directions
were given as to where the messengers were to be sent.
In these documents Vyshnegrad himself, was named
"Comrade No. 15". A document addressed to this nick-
name was found in his possession. This document was
a mandate granting him extensive power of attorney.
Vyshnegrad had current accounts in several banks, but
in every case they were not large. The murder is
supposed to have been committed either as an act of
vengeance or by some fellow-partymen. Shortly before
the disappearance of Vyshnegrad, the deceased had
said that he had to be murdered and was afraid to
go out alone. Further enquiries into this very extra-
ordinary case, will no doubt disclose many more
interesting details.

Кто часто встрѣчали у игорнаго стола въ Бѣженскомъ собраніи

нице*. По словамъ послѣдне*, прощаясь онъ сказалъ, что идетъ

维什涅格拉德于一个半月前携带巨款抵达哈尔滨。抵达后，该特工过着挥霍的生活。挥霍金钱，进行大额纸牌赌博。许多人经常在难民俱乐部的赌桌旁遇到他，他喜欢在那里尝试“九浪”的运气。但维什涅格拉德运气不佳。他系统地输钱。随着地位不断下降，这名苏联特工结识了半上流社会的女士，甚至沦落到与街头女孩交往。他与其中一人同居。维什涅格拉德最后的公寓位于马市街35号。

维什涅格拉德在与熟人的谈话中曾表达过担心被杀的忧虑。据推测，他害怕同志们的报复。维什涅格拉德在华俄道胜银行有日元和美元的活期账户；但金额证明并不巨大。最后一次见到维什涅格拉德是在2月22日。晚上，他与一位女性朋友一起离开了公寓。据后者称，告别时他说要去切尔尼亚夫斯基医生那里。据推测他是这位医生的病人。此后未再见他活着。
